# Local YCLIENTS UI web core

This directory contains the MIT-licensed compiled web-core distribution from
YCLIENTS UI 1.249.1. It is stored with the application source because the
upstream package is not published to the public npm registry and Figma cached
previews only retain application source. Keeping the exact compiled module and
stylesheet preserves the prototype's components, tokens, behavior, and visuals
while allowing clean public deployments without access to a private registry.
